relationship_statement: Arctura Network is the public operational status surface for the open-source ARM subnet implementation. Arctura Observatory is the collective's public identity and archive. Autonomous Resource Management is the technical reference framework. The public code repository is the primary source for published implementation details.

surfaces.name: Arctura Network
surfaces.role: operational status and public implementation evidence

delegations.authority_boundary: operates infrastructure under Arctura Network direction; does not establish network, governance, token, treasury, or mainnet claims
delegations.commercial_status: bootstrapped; no current payment rail, currency, fee schedule, or payable obligation is published
delegations.future_compensation_boundary: services may be compensated only through a separately approved and published agreement; x402 or a future network currency are possibilities, not current commitments

source_precedence: published implementation artifact in the code repository
